files.description: Canonical portable paths, no duplicate case variants or file/directory collisions; total <=64 MiB.

action.description: Only revise accepts/requires a non-null spec. Enable requires current project approval permission.

revision.description: Immutable specification revision, incremented only by revise.

version.description: User-command CAS version; scheduler cursor movement does not consume this version.

available_hours.description: null is unknown; numeric capacity must be 0–168 hours.

authorization_ticket.description: Body-only short-lived opaque secret, memory transport only; not graph authority.
Body-only short-lived opaque secret, memory transport only; not graph authority.

expected_sha256.description: Frozen from actual manifest in plan; must be absent/empty in environment configuration requests.

password.description: Existing account password proof; new account password. Server requires 12–1024 UTF-8 bytes, which is not a JSON Schema character count.

token.description: One-time secret in JSON body only; UI accepts manual input or URL fragment, never query/log/localStorage.

grants.description: Unique same-organization project grants; server validates project ownership.

token.description: First creation only. Never included in listing or replay; retain only in component memory until dismissed.

role.description: Required except remove. owner requires owner-only transfer_owner action.

acceptance_percent.description: 100 * accepted_tasks / total_tasks; null when total_tasks is zero.

role.description: Required except remove; cannot exceed caller authority.

authorization_ticket.description: Short-lived opaque secret delivered only to current trusted assignment via this dedicated response. Never include in Assignment, Config, journal, browser storage or evidence.

tasks.description: Unique current accepted tasks actually delivered by the same run as both selected proofs; versions and real review basis are validated atomically.

active_generation.description: Last observed active pointer; not the CAS basis for another deployment.

generation.description: Highest reserved fencing generation. May exceed active_generation after failed/unknown attempts.

revision.description: Immutable content revision; v1 always 1 and content edits create a new plan.

state.description: completed means execution ended, not necessarily deployed or healthy; read ReleaseDeployment effect/health separately.

version.description: Mutable decision CAS version, independent of immutable revision and sha256.

token.description: Once-only plaintext credential; absent from registry and same-key replay. Memory only, no browser session/local storage.

profiles.description: Unique administrator-owned profile IDs and real configuration digests. At least one profile or deployment=true is required.

message.description: Actual cumulative output tail. Server strips ANSI/control characters and redacts credential-shaped text; 1–8192 UTF-8 bytes.

estimated_hours.description: Required complete field. null is unknown; explicit 0 is known zero. Server accepts 0–100000 hours.

version.description: Independent plan version; 0 means no stored plan.

project_id.description: Empty/omitted for humans; required real project ID for Agent and tool resources.

bearerAuth.description: Project-scoped API credential; applicable routes enforce the bound project and scope.

cookieAuth.description: Browser session. Organization governance rejects every scoped API, Runner and Agent project token.
cookieAuth.name: suma_session

providerAuth.description: Independent provider credential configured by the administrator. Not a browser, project API, Agent or Runner token; binds provider identity and authorized operation.

runnerAuth.description: Runner-scoped credential bound to this project; browser sessions, Agent and API tokens are rejected.
